exam.title: Transforming Contact Center Experiences with AI in Dynamics 365
exam.study_prerequisites: Contact-center/CCaaS implementation knowledge across voice and digital channels, representatives/supervisors, routing and service operations, plus experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Power BI, Teams and Microsoft Foundry.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Configure the Dynamics 365 Contact Center representative experience
Manage analytics for the Dynamics 365 Contact Center

review.notes: Every subobjective on the official May 15, 2026 guide is mapped to a deployment, channel/journey, identity/data/compliance boundary, agent/Copilot contract, work-distribution decision, representative/supervisor experience, operational metric, evidence, failure or recovery path. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover standalone/embedded/third-party CCaaS, connectors, simulation/Health/transformation agents, Agent hub/solutions/ALM/users/roles/capacity, chat/digital/SDK/API/translation, voice/IVR/numbers/calling/recording/CCaaS API, context/customer ID/transfer/masking/messages/timeline/CIF/attachments, proactive campaigns/dialing/WFM, Copilot/knowledge/plugins/smart assist, voice orchestration/DTMF/NLU/speech/SIP/multilingual, queues/overflow/assignment/routing/diagnostics, profiles/templates/inbox/scripts/macros/APIs/knowledge agent, supervisors/quality, Power BI and Application Insights. All 11 cited URLs were reachable. The guide records the active 120-minute English exam, no official Practice Assessment, 11h40 official paths, three-day course, LinkedIn Learning with an adjacent-content caveat, MB-240 non-direct transition, and no exact verified Pluralsight, O'Reilly, MeasureUp or Whizlabs product.

findings.title: New ACS number cutoff and eligibility remain inconsistent
findings.evidence: September 23/30 cutoff conflict and resource-only versus existing-number wording remain across current official pages.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Monitor drift is snapshot presentation, not objective change
findings.evidence: All 119 parsed detailed bullets exactly match the accepted baseline.
findings.recommendation: Normalize current snapshots and archive original evidence bytes/paths without changing historical hashes or outcomes.
findings.resolution: Normalize current snapshots and archive original evidence bytes/paths without changing historical hashes or outcomes.

findings.title: ACS retirement differs from immediate loss of existing service
findings.evidence: Current affected configurations remain supported through September 30 2028.
findings.recommendation: Add migration scope and future planning dates while isolating new-number uncertainty.
findings.resolution: Add migration scope and future planning dates while isolating new-number uncertainty.

findings.title: Apple onboarding and old forecasting have near-term removals
findings.evidence: Apple configuration September 30; legacy forecasting October 30.
findings.recommendation: Add lifecycle watch, WEM replacement and dated follow-ups.
findings.resolution: Add lifecycle watch, WEM replacement and dated follow-ups.

findings.title: Voice has separate ACS and Teams Phone extensibility setup paths
findings.evidence: Dedicated Teams resource-account/sync procedure qualifies older FAQ.
findings.recommendation: Replace generic telephony paragraph with scoped setup table and migration evidence.
findings.resolution: Replace generic telephony paragraph with scoped setup table and migration evidence.

findings.title: Direct Routing coexistence cannot reuse one SBC FQDN
findings.evidence: ACS and Teams cannot own the same FQDN simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Add alias/certificate versus cutover decision and validation sequence.
findings.resolution: Add alias/certificate versus cutover decision and validation sequence.

findings.title: CRM synchronization and embedded UI are separate contracts
findings.evidence: Source identifiers, incremental events, pagination and environment scope matter.
findings.recommendation: Add connector lifecycle and Salesforce widget boundary.
findings.resolution: Add connector lifecycle and Salesforce widget boundary.

findings.title: Conversational setup cannot configure every routing rule
findings.evidence: Unconditional routing supported; classification, conditions, overflow and custom assignment excluded.
findings.recommendation: Add current agent responsibilities, prerequisites and manual configuration boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add current agent responsibilities, prerequisites and manual configuration boundaries.

findings.title: Agent simulation cannot test every journey
findings.evidence: Preview English inbound voice only, bounded calls and no DTMF.
findings.recommendation: Add scope matrix and wall-time/aggregate-time example without billing extrapolation.
findings.resolution: Add scope matrix and wall-time/aggregate-time example without billing extrapolation.

findings.title: Deleting a rollout does not disable every underlying agent
findings.evidence: Intent/Knowledge settings survive plan deletion; Case Management differs.
findings.recommendation: Add feature-specific rollback checks.
findings.resolution: Add feature-specific rollback checks.

findings.title: Multiple profiles intersect and release/reset rules differ
findings.evidence: Every attached profile must fit; manual assignment and custom limits have distinct effects.
findings.recommendation: Add capacity example and diagnosis/release boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add capacity example and diagnosis/release boundaries.

findings.title: Operating-hour calendars need explicit target configuration
findings.evidence: Calendar cannot migrate through the documented export/import options.
findings.recommendation: Add ALM exception and default-hours/action checks.
findings.resolution: Add ALM exception and default-hours/action checks.

findings.title: Masking scope differs by channel, direction and destination
findings.evidence: Message masking is not identical to sensitive-variable or custom-log protection.
findings.recommendation: Add masking matrix, first-answer timing and pause-completion tests.
findings.resolution: Add masking matrix, first-answer timing and pause-completion tests.

findings.title: Outbound controls depend on path, queue state and customer time zone
findings.evidence: Preview timing differs on Teams/ACS, missing time zone falls back to UTC, cancellation queued-only.
findings.recommendation: Add current dial/intake/retry/stop controls and fixed-offset quiet-hour example.
findings.resolution: Add current dial/intake/retry/stop controls and fixed-offset quiet-hour example.

findings.title: WEM scenarios replace older forecasting with explicit lifecycle
findings.evidence: Horizon, refresh, immutable inputs, planning groups and snapshots are documented.
findings.recommendation: Add supported scenario behavior and bounded staffing arithmetic.
findings.resolution: Add supported scenario behavior and bounded staffing arithmetic.

findings.title: Workforce tool decisions cover time-off only
findings.evidence: List/detail supports swaps/bids; decision requires pending time-off and reviewer permission.
findings.recommendation: Add role/action matrix, replay limits and future-tool distinction.
findings.resolution: Add role/action matrix, replay limits and future-tool distinction.

findings.title: Real-time voice and digital agents have different evidence limits
findings.evidence: Digital preview/auth and model/geography/transcript constraints apply.
findings.recommendation: Add channel-specific checks, conversion limitation and incomplete-transcript warning.
findings.resolution: Add channel-specific checks, conversion limitation and incomplete-transcript warning.

findings.title: Fallback, prequeue and postqueue checks are different
findings.evidence: Fallback bypasses overflow; prequeue runs once; postqueue/playbooks have different reevaluation.
findings.recommendation: Add routing sequence, cached-count and continuous-playbook boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add routing sequence, cached-count and continuous-playbook boundaries.

findings.title: Intent scope must align chat workstream and business line
findings.evidence: LOB/rule configuration determines which intent context applies.
findings.recommendation: Add scope, reviewed intents and knowledge/authorization boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add scope, reviewed intents and knowledge/authorization boundaries.

findings.title: Knowledge harvesting needs distinct configuration and input scope
findings.evidence: Connections, flows, publication, source attributes and closed-record triggers differ.
findings.recommendation: Add knowledge-agent prerequisites and scoped author/reviewer controls.
findings.resolution: Add knowledge-agent prerequisites and scoped author/reviewer controls.

findings.title: Quality scoring can be irreversible and has distinct record types
findings.evidence: Criteria scoring cannot be turned off; email evaluation remains preview.
findings.recommendation: Add prerequisite/role and configuration decision boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add prerequisite/role and configuration decision boundaries.

findings.title: Guardrail violations are not numeric score components
findings.evidence: Quality library/plan separates indicators, violations, sampling and timing.
findings.recommendation: Add weighted sampling/score example and use limitations.
findings.resolution: Add weighted sampling/score example and use limitations.

findings.title: Diagnostic categories overlap and telemetry has limited scope
findings.evidence: Rejected/no eligible can overlap; OOB assignment-only, transfer/consult excluded, data lags.
findings.recommendation: Add event-time investigation, distinct-ID example and correct-containment denominators.
findings.resolution: Add event-time investigation, distinct-ID example and correct-containment denominators.

findings.title: Official learning outlines expose modules but not current total durations
findings.evidence: The implementation path exposes four modules; the four paths together expose 16. Previously captured path durations are not exposed by the current fetched pages.
findings.recommendation: Retain the module count, label older durations historical and distinguish the editorial study budget from provider timing.
findings.resolution: Retain the module count, label older durations historical and distinguish the editorial study budget from provider timing.
